doc.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019

title: Pay and the decision about college
summary: He made about ten dollars a night, and his parents insisted he go to college rather than just play.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you recall what you made per night?
Do you recall how much money you made?
Oh, ten dollars or something like that. That was considered a lot of money back then.
Yeah. Great story. At that time then, by the time you had done those gigs and you were thinking about college, had you decided on a career in music?
